snippet.title: Half-Life : Retribution (Walkthrough)
snippet.description:
As with Chernobyl this was originally an illegal stand alone version but it has now been packaged as a mod.

- Rail Cannon : https://gamebanana.com/mods/180489
- Half-Life Reanimation HD pack : https://www.moddb.com/games/half-life/addons/half-life-reanimation-pack-hd
- Weapons of Rebellion Remod : https://www.moddb.com/mods/vengellion-remod/downloads/vengeance-rebellion-remod
- Half-Life: Soldiers Pack : https://www.moddb.com/games/half-life/addons/half-life-soldiers-pack
- HD Barney with MP5 / 9mmar : https://gamebanana.com/mods/364985
- Half-Life - Gonarch Reanimation (By - MTB) : https://www.moddb.com/games/half-life/addons/bigmomma

Can Link : https://www.runthinkshootlive.com/posts/retribution/
